renderSettings.stageCrop: Individual current alpha bounds plus 3 CSS px margin; shared family scale does not reserve future geometry.
renderSettings.completedPosters: Registered frame-zero posters from animation/source-record.json; settled last-frame poster for ending.

provenanceNote: Each static pass lists its actual imported sources and any hash differences from currentSources. Reused images were checked for unchanged selected geometry and current camera. Derived carried images use the same source render at their authored scale. Completed posters are selected from the frozen animation exports, not the construction passes. Disposable masters, render logs and review packets are not retained; runtime hashes and canonical source geometry are the design deliverables.
